rules.title: Event Rules
rules.lock: From its start time the event is read-only: guests, messages, seating and settings can no longer be changed.
rules.rsvp: Guests can submit and update their RSVP until the event starts. After that the RSVP page is closed.
rules.exports: Viewing the event and downloading exports stay available after the event.
rules.maxAttendees: Maximum attendees is a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
rules.allowed: The maximum attendees per guest is a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}. It limits what every guest can confirm, and new guests start with it as their Expected Attendees. Lowering it keeps answers already given.
rules.warnings: Capacity warnings never block saving. They appear when confirmed attendance exceeds the maximum, or when the number of seats differs from it.
rules.date: The event's date and time can be changed only to a time in the future.
rules.roles: Owners and Admins can change the event. Viewers can view it and download exports.

permissions.subtitle: Manage who can access this event and what they can do.

about.title: About event roles
about.body: An Owner can manage everything in the event. An Admin can manage the event but cannot delete or duplicate it, and cannot change an Owner. A Viewer can view the event and download exports.
